Our Operating Company, ONGC, is looking for an experienced IT Support Engineer, Level 2 to join their team in Arundel, GQ.

About The Role

As a Level 2 IT Support Engineer, you'll provide advanced technical support across a diverse range of client environments while managing escalated issues from the Level 1 team. You'll take ownership of incidents from diagnosis through to resolution, contribute to infrastructure improvements, and help deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 technical support across desktop, server, network, and cloud environments.
  • Manage escalated incidents and service requests, ensuring timely resolution.
  • Troubleshoot Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Exchange, and Windows environments.
  • Support networking technologies including firewalls, switches, VPNs, and wireless infrastructure.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and ticket updates within the PSA system.
  • Build strong client relationships through professional communication and outstanding customer service.
  • Assist with infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and technology projects.
  • Collaborate with Level 3 Engineers on complex technical issues when required.

About You

To succeed in this role, you will ideally have MSP experience, excellent troubleshooting skills, and a proactive approach to customer support.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 3+years' experience in an MSP or similar IT support environment.
  • Relevant IT qualifications or equivalent industry experience.
  • Experience providing Level 2 support across Microsoft environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Exchange Online, andWindows Server.
  • Experience supporting networking technologies including switches, firewalls, VPNs and Wi-Fi.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Microsoft certifications (MS-900, AZ-900, MD-102, MS-102, AZ-104, or similar).
  • CompTIA, Cisco, or ITIL certifications.
  • Experience with ConnectWise PSA and ConnectWise RMM.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Intune, SharePoint, Microsoft Defender, or Azure Virtual Desktop

  • Flexible working arrangements – 2 days WFH

About Us
Established in 1977, Palm Lake Group is a proudly Australian, family-owned business with extensive experience in developing, constructing, and managing Lifestyle Resorts, Retirement Villages, and Aged Care Facilities across Australia. Our resorts aren't just places to live they're vibrant, active communities designed for comfort, connection, and enjoyment.

Join us in redefining over-50s living.

Position Details
We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused IT Support Analyst to join our IT team based at our Southport Head Office. Supporting staff across Palm Lake Group's operations in Queensland, New South Wales, and Victoria, you will provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support, resolve technical issues, manage service requests, and help deliver reliable and secure IT services across the business. This is a full-time permanent position reporting to the IT Business Partner.

Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to staff across Palm Lake Group.
  • Log, track, and manage incidents and service requests through ServiceNow.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, Microsoft 365, connectivity, and device issues.
  • Configure and deploy laptops, desktops and mobile devices using Microsoft Intune.
  • Manage user accounts, access and permissions across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Develop and maintain IT documentation, user guides, and support resources.
  • Assist with IT projects, equipment rollouts, relocations, and system improvements.
  • Provide onsite support at Palm Lake Group locations as required.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to resolve issues and improve service delivery.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of IT processes, systems, and user experience.

What We're Looking For:
To succeed in this role, you'll bring:

  • 3+ years experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk, or IT Support role.
  • Experience using ServiceNow or a similar IT Service Management (ITSM) platform.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows, Microsoft 365, printers, mobile devices, and business applications.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Understanding of Microsoft 365 administration and end-user support.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and secure account management.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • A positive, team-focused attitude with a willingness to learn and adapt.
  • Ability to travel locally and interstate on occasion to support Palm Lake Group operations.

Why Join Us?
At Palm Lake, we pride ourselves on offering exceptional lifestyle communities and providing our staff with a supportive and rewarding work environment. We offer our team:

  • Competitive Remuneration
  • Free Parking in Southport CBD
  • Work-life Balance with flexible working hours (Between 7am-5pm, Mon to Fri)
  • 24/7 free access to compassionate, confidential support with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Gold Coast | Newly Created Position | Office-based leadership role  

We’re partnering with an established Gold Coast Managed Services Provider to find a technically strong people leader who can develop the team, improve service delivery and take ownership of the service desk’s performance.

MSP experience and full working rights in Australia are essential for this position.

What’s in it for you?
  • A newly created position with scope to influence processes, standards and team development.
  • An opportunity to step up from technical team leadership or bring your existing service desk management experience.
  • A role that combines hands-on technical involvement with people leadership.
The opportunity
This role brings together technical leadership, people development and service delivery. You’ll help shape how the service desk operates, establish clear expectations and build consistent practices that support both the team and its clients.

You’ll need to be comfortable coaching engineers, managing priorities and stepping into complex technical escalations. Working with the CTO, you’ll turn recurring issues into lasting improvements and help the team deliver reliable, well-documented support.

What you’ll be doing
  • Leading, coaching and developing technical staff, including supporting individual training and certification plans.
  • Taking ownership of service desk priorities, ticket quality, escalations and SLA performance.
  • Providing senior technical guidance and helping resolve complex infrastructure, cloud, networking and security issues.
  • Reviewing ageing and reopened tickets, identifying recurring problems and driving permanent fixes.
  • Improving documentation, troubleshooting practices and communication with clients.
  • Overseeing patch compliance, backup reliability and scheduled restore testing.
  • Working with the CTO to agree performance targets and review progress quarterly.
  • Supporting major incidents and scheduled changes outside standard hours when required.
What you’ll bring
You may currently be a Technical Team Lead, Service Desk Team Leader or Service Desk Manager. Your title matters less than your ability to lead people, make sound technical decisions and improve service delivery.
You will need:
  • Previous experience working within an MSP.
  • Full working rights in Australia.
  • At least eight years’ experience in IT support and infrastructure, including three years in a senior escalation or technical lead role.
  • At least two years’ experience leading or managing technical staff.
  • Demonstrated success improving SLA performance and service quality in a ticket-driven environment.
  • A calm, clear communication style and the ability to coach people constructively.
  • A current driver’s licence, reliable transport and willingness to complete a National Police Check.
Your technical background
You’ll bring strong troubleshooting capability across Microsoft and business infrastructure environments, with experience covering:
  • Microsoft Server and virtualisation: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, RDS, file and print services, Hyper-V, VMware and/or Proxmox VE.
  • Modern workplace: Windows 11, Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Conditional Access and Defender.
  • Cloud infrastructure: Azure infrastructure, networking, identity integration and backup, plus AWS services such as EC2, VPC and IAM.
  • Networking: Routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, wireless and internet services.
  • Security and resilience: MFA, MDR, email security, system hardening, incident response, backup and disaster recovery.
Experience with ConnectWise PSA, NinjaOne, IT Glue, Sophos, Veeam or Datto BCDR will be highly regarded, as will Linux administration, scripting and automation, and relevant Microsoft, Cisco or ITIL certifications.

What success looks like
Your impact will show through a more capable team, stronger client satisfaction, consistent SLA performance and fewer recurring issues. You’ll help create a service desk where tickets are owned, documentation is useful and engineers have a clear path to develop.

Working across multiple concurrent projects, you'll coordinate stakeholders, manage timelines, oversee website implementation, monitor quality standards and ensure projects are delivered on time and to scope.

This role combines hands-on website management with strong project coordination skills, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both the technical and organisational aspects of digital delivery.

  • Support website launches and transition projects into business-as-usual ownership

  • Implement on-page SEO and website performance standards
  • Coordinate analytics, tracking and conversion measurement requirements
  • Monitor and resolve website issues to ensure high-quality outcomes

Security, Privacy & Compliance

  • Support security, privacy and procurement approval processes for web platforms and vendors
  • Assist with risk assessments and approval documentation
  • Ensure approved tools, plugins and integrations meet organisational standards
  • Coordinate with internal technical, security and infrastructure teams when required

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with content, creative, CRM and digital marketing specialists
  • Engage business stakeholders and external suppliers to drive project outcomes
  • Evaluate project performance and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Maintain reusable templates, processes and project documentation
  • Contribute ideas that improve website delivery and digital performance

jobs.job_description:
You know manufacturing.

Not just that factories are full of expensive machinery, production schedules rarely go exactly to plan, and the words "the system is down" can make an Operations Manager's blood pressure rise faster than a Friday afternoon production deadline.

You understand how manufacturing businesses actually operate, how business owners and operations leaders think, how technology decisions get made, and why reliability matters more than the cheapest quote.

Maybe you've sold manufacturing technology. Maybe you've worked in manufacturing IT. Maybe you've helped manufacturers modernise production systems, cybersecurity, ERP platforms, infrastructure or cloud environments.

Whatever your path, you know that manufacturing businesses don't buy technology for technology's sake. They buy outcomes.

First Focus is looking for a Manufacturing Technology Consultant to help Australian manufacturers confidently navigate AI, cybersecurity, managed IT and cloud transformation.

We are Australia's leading managed AI and IT services provider, and our marketing engine delivers a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities from businesses already looking to improve how they work.

This is an individual contributor role. It isn't a graduate sales position, and it isn't a lead generation role. You'll need to arrive with strong commercial instincts, excellent discovery skills, genuine depth of manufacturing industry knowledge and the ability to build credibility quickly with business owners, Managing Directors, Operations Managers and manufacturing leaders.


What You'll Be Doing

You'll work with small and mid-sized manufacturing businesses, typically between 20 and 250 users, who are reviewing their technology strategy, cybersecurity, AI roadmap or existing IT partner.

AI is rapidly changing manufacturing.

Business owners and operations leaders want to know how Microsoft Copilot, secure AI assistants and automation can improve production planning, inventory management, reporting, supply chain visibility and productivity without compromising operational reliability, data security or business continuity.

You'll help manufacturers move beyond AI curiosity into practical, secure and commercially sensible adoption.

You'll lead the commercial conversation from qualification through to proposal and close. That means understanding how the business operates, where technology is creating friction, how decisions are made, who needs to be involved and what success looks like.

You'll work closely with technical specialists, solution architects and delivery teams, but you'll own the client relationship and sales process. You'll be expected to quickly develop a strong understanding of First Focus's AI, cybersecurity, cloud and managed services offerings, confidently lead technical and commercial conversations, and translate these services into outcomes that resonate with business owners, operations leaders and manufacturing executives. You'll be expected to quickly master the key technical talking points and confidently lead client conversations independently, bringing in technical specialists for genuinely complex requirements rather than routine discussions.

You'll write clear, commercially credible proposals that explain the business case for change, while ensuring smooth handovers into implementation because a successful sale doesn't end with a signature.

And in manufacturing, a successful implementation means a lot more than everyone being able to log into their laptops on Monday morning.


About You

You understand that selling into manufacturing businesses is different.

Trust is earned. Reliability matters. Downtime matters. Relationships matter.

You know how to have commercial conversations with professionals who expect you to understand their business before talking about yours.

You understand that when production stops, the consequences aren't just technical. They can mean missed deadlines, lost revenue, disrupted supply chains and some fairly unhappy customers.

You're also naturally curious about AI and already using it to improve the way you work, whether that's research, writing, preparation, productivity or client engagement.

You'll probably be a great fit if you have:

  • At least five years' experience in consultative B2B sales, solution consulting or technology consulting, with sustained exposure to the manufacturing industry.

  • Demonstrated depth of experience selling into manufacturing businesses or working directly within manufacturing, industrial or production environments. You'll understand manufacturing workflows, operational systems and decision-making processes, and be able to explain technology decisions you've personally influenced and the outcomes delivered.

  • Experience with managed services, manufacturing technology, cybersecurity, cloud, AI, ERP systems, infrastructure or operational technology.

  • Confidence engaging with Managing Directors, Business Owners, CEOs, CFOs, COOs, Operations Managers, Production Managers and IT decision-makers.

  • Strong discovery skills and the discipline to qualify opportunities properly.

  • Excellent written communication and proposal development skills.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to quickly become confident discussing AI, cybersecurity, cloud and managed services independently, including the key capabilities, risks and business outcomes, without routinely relying on technical specialists to lead client conversations.

  • High commercial standards and the expectation that your remuneration reflects the value you create.

Experience with manufacturing technologies, manufacturing execution and production management platforms would be highly regarded, but isn't essential.

An understanding of operational technology (OT), industrial networks, production environments or the challenges of connecting factory-floor systems with business IT would also be valuable.

You don't need to know how to repair a CNC machine. But understanding why an unexpected production outage is a bigger problem than someone's Outlook calendar refusing to synchronise would certainly help.

This role probably isn't the right fit if your experience has been primarily lead generation, transactional product sales or heavily supported enterprise sales where large bid teams carry most of the commercial process.

We're specifically looking for someone who understands the manufacturing industry, not simply a generalist technology consultant looking for a new market to sell into.


What Great Looks Like

Within six months you'll be confidently leading strategic and technical conversations with business owners, Managing Directors and manufacturing leaders, independently communicating the value of First Focus's services, converting qualified opportunities into long-term managed services clients and becoming a trusted advisor to manufacturers navigating AI and technology change.

You'll build credibility because you understand the commercial realities of manufacturing.

You'll earn trust internally because you qualify thoroughly, sell accurately and hand over opportunities that delivery teams genuinely enjoy implementing.

Most importantly, you'll help Australian manufacturers embrace AI safely, improve cybersecurity, modernise infrastructure, reduce operational risk and create better experiences for their employees and customers.

You'll understand that technology should support production, not become another reason production stops.


Why First Focus

Manufacturing businesses don't need another IT supplier.

They need a technology partner who understands operational reliability, cyber risk, business continuity and how manufacturing businesses actually work.

First Focus is Australia's leading managed AI and IT services provider, with more than 350 specialists across Australia, New Zealand and the Philippines.

We're helping Australian businesses use AI in practical, secure and commercially valuable ways. Behind every conversation you'll have is deep technical capability across managed AI, managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud, Microsoft technologies, modern workplace and business technology.

You'll have genuine delivery capability behind you, a trusted brand in the market and a marketing engine generating qualified demand.

You won't spend your days cold calling from a spreadsheet.

You'll spend them helping manufacturers that already know they need to modernise, making smart technology decisions that improve productivity, reduce risk, strengthen business continuity and create lasting client relationships.

Our First Focus values include Be the Solution, which fits this role particularly well. We believe in taking ownership, solving problems and following through, rather than selling technology and leaving someone else to deal with the consequences.

Because when a manufacturer's systems stop working, "have you tried turning it off and on again?" isn't always the commercially sensible answer.

Learn more about First Focus and our values at https://www.firstfocus.com.au/about-us/.


What You'll Get

  • A competitive base salary between $150,000–$200,000 base excluding superannuation, plus up to $100k OTE

  • A strong pipeline of qualified opportunities, supported by an established marketing engine.
